name: OTel-LLM-1.2B-IT
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct (config.json max_position_embeddings 128000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-28. A finetune of LiquidAI/LFM2.5-1.2B-Instruct, not a new base model: same config.json, same 1.17 parameters (identical tensor set). Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence apache-2.0, repo created 2026-03-10. CAVEAT: measures context-grounded generation from retrieved context, not context-free QA; one private telecom corpus, one metric, two LLM judges.

benchmarks.name: LLM-as-judge correctness (OTel held-out 10%)
benchmarks.config: Card table 'OTel vs. Base Model': Base model 66.4% vs OTel fine-tuned 73.8% +/- 0.8, +7.4 pp. Average of two judges (GPT-4o mini, Claude Sonnet 3.5) scoring against retrieved context; bootstrap n=1000. Measures context-grounded generation, not context-free QA.
